description: Ballade SNG inputs and saved SNG2GS/Glosa MIDI outputs for converter compatibility testing.

postFixTieModel.rule: Tie records do not emit a new Note-on/off. Extend the latest pending Note-off for the same key whose scheduled tick is at or before the Tie start, to the Tie record's end tick.
